sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define what a 'Sprite' is in the context of Scratch programming. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A sprite is a 2D digital character, image, or object in Scratch that you program using code blocks to move, speak, or interact on the stage.

questions.question_text: What is the primary objective of creating a Class Museum project? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The main objective is to help students learn how to properly collect, categorize, label, and safely preserve historical or culturally significant objects for educational displays.

questions.question_text: List two essential hygiene rules to follow before starting any 'Cooking Without Fire' activity. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Before preparing any food, you must thoroughly wash your hands with soap and water, and ensure all raw ingredients are washed properly under clean running water.

questions.question_text: Describe a simple animation sequence you could create in Scratch where a character says 'Hello', changes its color, and moves across the screen. Mention the block categories used. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, use an 'Events' block to start the script. Next, snap a 'Looks' block to make the character say 'Hello' and another 'Looks' block to change its color effect. Finally, attach a 'Motion' block to move it 50 steps forward.
